# Postmortem: primary Postgres unavailable (3 Aug 2026)

Impact: checkout and login returned errors for 47 minutes.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 02:10 WAL archiving to object storage started failing after a credentials rotation.
- 02:10–04:52 WAL segments accumulated on the primary's volume.
- 04:52 Volume reached 100% usage; Postgres stopped accepting writes.
- 05:39 Expanded the volume and restored archiving credentials; service recovered.

## Root cause
Archive failures were not alerted on, so the volume filled silently.

## Follow-ups
- Alert when WAL archiving fails for more than 5 minutes.
- Alert at 80% volume usage.
